name: Mou Suki ni Shite Kudasai ~Ryoujoku to Kusari to Himitsu no Ana~
original_name: もう好きにしてください～凌辱と鎖と秘密の穴～
source:
There is an old western mansion on the hill of a small fisherman's town. It is owned by a chairman of a certain company. Main character is the son of that chairman. He lives in the mansion with four women servants. As of late he starts to pay them a lot of attention in attempt to record juicy moments on the camera.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-june-2000-age-maniax-isumi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一个小渔村的山上有一座古老的西洋宅邸。它的所有者是某公司的董事长。主角是那个董事长的儿子。他和四名女仆住在豪宅里。最近，他开始对他们给予很多关注，试图用相机记录下有趣的时刻。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-june-2000-age-maniax-isumi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
